ndc_assessment.summary: "Une réduction des émissions de gaz à effet de serre de 7 à 22%, à l'horizon 2030, par rapport à un scénario de référence (Business As Usual - BAU), subordonnée aux soutiens en matière de financements extérieurs, de développement et de transfert technologique et de renforcement des capacités. Les 7 % de réduction des GES seront réalisés avec les moyens nationaux." A greenhouse gas emission reduction of 7% to 22% by 2030 compared to business as usual (BAU) levels, conditional on external assistance for the financing of the development and transfer of technologies and capacity building. A 7% GHG reduction will be achieved with domestic means.

verdict.text: Algeria pledges a 7% reduction by 2030 against 2030 business-as-usual (unconditional), and 22% conditional. A later submission, NDC 3.0, was filed on 2026-06-24; it has not been read, so no figure here comes from it. The document's condition, in its own words: "The mitigation actions to be implemented by Algeria, planned for the 2021-2030 period, will lead to the following contribution: Reduction of greenhouse gases emissions by 7% to 22%, by 2030, compared to a business as usual -BAU- scenario, conditional on external support in terms of finance, technology development and transfer, and capacity building." 48 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (2). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 442.8 MtCO₂e, DS-35 276.1 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: the pledge is 7% below a business-as-usual projection for 2030. That projection is not in any source loaded here, so the percentage cannot be turned into a tonnage and the trend cannot be judged against it. It submitted BTR1. 3 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 47.4 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: 7% (with domestic means) to 22% (conditional) reduction in GHG emissions by 2030 compared to the BAU levels It was classed both. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.44°C under SSP1-2.6 to +5.66°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
